summary.name: StableBar
summary.one_liner: A native, customizable menu bar replacement for macOS with themes, script-driven widgets, popups and AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspace support.
use_cases: Replace the default macOS menu bar with a custom one
Show AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspaces on the bar
Show script output or system info as menu bar widgets
Show music, weather, GitHub or Homebrew status on the bar
Use different bar layouts for laptop screen, monitors or dark mode
summary.what_it_does: StableBar replaces the macOS menu bar with a configurable one that can be edited directly on the bar by dragging, adding or removing widgets, with Undo. Settings can be made in the app or in a JSON file with schema-based completion and validation, and the file is applied on save while the last working bar is kept if a change is invalid. Any widget can run a shell command that prints text or JSON, refreshed on a timer or events, and can open a popup built from rows, graphs, lists, buttons, sliders and search fields. It integrates with AeroSpace, yabai and OmniWM to show workspaces and windows, and offers a Store of community widgets whose commands and permissions are shown before they run.
notable: Workspace integration with AeroSpace, yabai and OmniWM
Any shell script can be a widget, with popups for graphs and lists
Per-display, per-screen-kind and profile-based layouts and themes, with notch awareness
Widget Store showing commands, hosts and permissions before install; SHA-256 checks on downloads
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon
Store packages are optional and come from community or private sources
